name: Shikabane Gonta
source:
Bruto Cadaverini is a powerful mob boss in Los Angeles.

[Spoiler]
He has a granddaughter, [url=https://vndb.org/c14391]Viola[/url], for whom he cares very deeply. One day, Viola suffered a car crash with [url=https://vndb.org/c14422]Furio Tigre[/url]'s scooter. Because of this, Viola required an operation on her head that would cost $1 million. Furious about what had happened to his beloved granddaughter, Bruto demanded that Tigre pay the bill. Bruto had a great deal of criminal influence, so Tigre couldn't refuse and was left in debt.
[/Spoiler]

[Taken from [URL=http://aceattorney.wikia.com/wiki/Bruto_Cadaverini] his Ace Attorney Wiki page[/URL].]
